answer: Cap total new identities per epoch and sell those slots by sealed bid, so entry itself is the scarce good. Each bid escrows 400 POA for three epochs; the clearing price is published before allocation, and doubling demand doubles what every bidder pays. A bidder who proves a forgery loses the escrow, and honest losers are refunded minus two percent. At a 500-slot cap and 60 POA clearing price, 1000 clones cannot all enter and pay 60000 POA to compete for seats. The cipher auction log, plume of published clearing prices and a forge-verified challenge window make allocation auditable.
